headline: Video: BI Rate Naik Jadi 6%, IHSG Volatil dan Rupiah Masih Melemah
summary: Bank Indonesia raised its BI Rate to 6 percent. The Jakarta Composite Index turned volatile and the rupiah remained under pressure.
why: Bank Indonesia's policy rate sets borrowing costs across the economy and influences capital flows into the rupiah and local equities.
why_moved: The rate increase to 6 percent was announced alongside volatility in the Jakarta Composite Index and continued rupiah weakness.
